name: Maachah
bio: Maachah, daughter of Absalom, was Rehoboam's favorite among his many wives and concubines; he made her son Abijah chief among his brothers, intending him to be king (2 Chronicles 11:18-22). Oddly, 2 Chronicles 13:2 names Abijah's mother as Michaiah, daughter of Uriel of Gibeah, rather than Maachah, daughter of Absalom — most likely the same woman known by two names and two lines of descent. She was the queen mother through the reigns of both Abijam and his son Asa (1 Kings 15:2, 10) — likely Asa's grandmother rather than his literal mother, since "queen mother" in the royal court was an official position rather than strictly a parental title. When Asa came to the throne and did what was right in the LORD's eyes, he removed Maachah from her position as queen mother because she had made a repulsive Asherah pole; Asa cut it down and burned it in the Kidron Valley (1 Kings 15:13).
